description.arabic: الإيمان بأن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمدًا رسول الله
description.english: Belief that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah

text.english: "Know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah"

text.arabic: قال رسول الله ﷺ: «بني الإسلام على خمس...»
text.english: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Islam is built upon five..."

description.english: Performing the five daily obligatory prayers

text.arabic: قال رسول الله ﷺ: «رأس الأمر الإسلام وعموده الصلاة»
text.english: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The pillar of the religion is prayer"

description.arabic: إخراج جزء من المال للفقراء والمحتاجين
description.english: Giving a portion of wealth to those in need

text.arabic: قال رسول الله ﷺ: «أُمروا أن يشهدوا... ويؤتوا الزكاة»
text.english: They were commanded to testify... and give zakah

description.arabic: صيام شهر رمضان من الفجر حتى المغرب
description.english: Fasting during the month of Ramadan from dawn to sunset

text.arabic: قال رسول الله ﷺ: «من صام رمضان إيمانًا واحتسابًا غُفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه»
text.english: Whoever fasts Ramadan with faith and seeking reward will have his past sins forgiven

description.arabic: حج بيت الله الحرام لمن استطاع إليه سبيلاً
description.english: Pilgrimage to the Sacred House (Kaaba) for those who are able

text.english: "And [due] to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House"

text.arabic: قال رسول الله ﷺ: «من حج فلم يرفث ولم يفسق رجع كيوم ولدته أمه»
text.english: Whoever performs Hajj properly returns free of sins like the day he was born
